paragraphs.text: translated by
1. THERE are the Dawn and Night, the grand and beauteous Pair, Earth, Heaven, and Varuna, Mitra, and Aryaman.
paragraphs.original: उषासानक्ता बृहती सुपेशसा द्यावाक्षामा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
paragraphs.translit: uṣāsānaktā bṛhatī supeśasā dyāvākṣāmā varuṇo mitro aryamā |

paragraphs.text: Indra I call, the Maruts, Mountains, and the Floods, Adityas, Heaven and Earth, the Waters, and the Sky.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रं हुवे मरुतः पर्वताँ अप आदित्यान्द्यावापृथिवी अपः स्वः
paragraphs.translit: indraṃ huve marutaḥ parvatām̐ apa ādityāndyāvāpṛthivī apaḥ svaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. May Dyaus and Prthivi, wise, true to Holy Law, keep us in safety from distress and injury.
paragraphs.original: द्यौश्च नः पृथिवी च प्रचेतस ऋतावरी रक्षतामंहसो रिषः ।
paragraphs.translit: dyauśca naḥ pṛthivī ca pracetasa ṛtāvarī rakṣatāmaṃhaso riṣaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Let not malignant Nirrti rule over us. We crave to-day this gracious favour of the Gods.
paragraphs.original: मा दुर्विदत्रा निरृतिर्न ईशत तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: mā durvidatrā nirṛtirna īśata taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 3. Mother of Mitra and of opulent Varuna, may Aditi preserve us safe from all distress.
paragraphs.original: विश्वस्मान्नो अदितिः पात्वंहसो माता मित्रस्य वरुणस्य रेवतः ।
paragraphs.translit: viśvasmānno aditiḥ pātvaṃhaso mātā mitrasya varuṇasya revataḥ |

paragraphs.text: May we obtain the light of heaven without a foe. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.
paragraphs.original: स्वर्वज्ज्योतिरवृकं नशीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: svarvajjyotiravṛkaṃ naśīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 4. May ringing press-stones keep the Raksasas afar, ill dream, and Nirrti, and each voracious fiend.
paragraphs.original: ग्रावा वदन्नप रक्षांसि सेधतु दुष्वप्न्यं निरृतिं विश्वमत्रिणम् ।
paragraphs.translit: grāvā vadannapa rakṣāṃsi sedhatu duṣvapnyaṃ nirṛtiṃ viśvamatriṇam |

paragraphs.text: May the Adityas and the Maruts shelter us. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.
paragraphs.original: आदित्यं शर्म मरुतामशीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: ādityaṃ śarma marutāmaśīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 5. Full flow libations; on our grass let Indra sit; Brhaspati the singer laud with Sama hymns!
paragraphs.original: एन्द्रो बर्हिः सीदतु पिन्वतामिळा बृहस्पतिः सामभिरृक्वो अर्चतु ।
paragraphs.translit: endro barhiḥ sīdatu pinvatāmiḷā bṛhaspatiḥ sāmabhirṛkvo arcatu |

paragraphs.text: Wise be our hearts' imaginings that we may live. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.
paragraphs.original: सुप्रकेतं जीवसे मन्म धीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: supraketaṃ jīvase manma dhīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 6. Ye Asvins, make our sacrifice ascend to heaven, and animate the rite that it may send us bliss,
paragraphs.original: दिविस्पृशं यज्ञमस्माकमश्विना जीराध्वरं कृणुतं सुम्नमिष्टये ।
paragraphs.translit: divispṛśaṃ yajñamasmākamaśvinā jīrādhvaraṃ kṛṇutaṃ sumnamiṣṭaye |

paragraphs.text: Offered with holy oil, with forward-speeding rein. We crave the gracious favour of the Gods to-day.
paragraphs.original: प्राचीनरश्मिमाहुतं घृतेन तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: prācīnaraśmimāhutaṃ ghṛtena taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 7. Hither I call the band of Maruts, swift to hear, great, purifying, bringing bliss, to he our Friends.
paragraphs.original: उप ह्वये सुहवं मारुतं गणं पावकमृष्वं सख्याय शम्भुवम् ।
paragraphs.translit: upa hvaye suhavaṃ mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ pāvakamṛṣvaṃ sakhyāya śambhuvam |

paragraphs.text: May we increase our wealth to glorify our name. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.
paragraphs.original: रायस्पोषं सौश्रवसाय धीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: rāyaspoṣaṃ sauśravasāya dhīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 8. We bring the Stay of Life, who makes the waters swell, swift-hearing, Friend of Gods, who waits on sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: अपां पेरुं जीवधन्यं भरामहे देवाव्यं सुहवमध्वरश्रियम् ।
paragraphs.translit: apāṃ peruṃ jīvadhanyaṃ bharāmahe devāvyaṃ suhavamadhvaraśriyam |

paragraphs.text: May we control that Power, Soma whose rays are bright. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.
paragraphs.original: सुरश्मिं सोममिन्द्रियं यमीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: suraśmiṃ somamindriyaṃ yamīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 9. Alive ourselves, with living sons, devoid of guilt, may we win this with winners by fair means to win.
paragraphs.original: सनेम तत्सुसनिता सनित्वभिर्वयं जीवा जीवपुत्रा अनागसः ।
paragraphs.translit: sanema tatsusanitā sanitvabhirvayaṃ jīvā jīvaputrā anāgasaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Let the prayer-haters bear our sin to every side. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.
paragraphs.original: ब्रह्मद्विषो विष्वगेनो भरेरत तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: brahmadviṣo viṣvageno bharerata taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 10. Hear us, O ye who claim the worship of mankind, and give us, O ye Gods, the gift for which we pray,
paragraphs.original: ये स्था मनोर्यज्ञियास्ते शृणोतन यद्वो देवा ईमहे तद्ददातन ।
paragraphs.translit: ye sthā manoryajñiyāste śṛṇotana yadvo devā īmahe taddadātana |

paragraphs.text: Victorious wisdom, fame with heroes and with wealth. We crave to-day this gracious favour of the Gods.
paragraphs.original: जैत्रं क्रतुं रयिमद्वीरवद्यशस्तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: jaitraṃ kratuṃ rayimadvīravadyaśastaddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 11. We crave the gracious favour of the Gods to-day, great favour of great Gods, sublime and free from foes,
paragraphs.original: महदद्य महतामा वृणीमहेऽवो देवानां बृहतामनर्वणाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: mahadadya mahatāmā vṛṇīmahe'vo devānāṃ bṛhatāmanarvaṇām |

paragraphs.text: That we may gain rich treasure sprung from hero sons. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.
paragraphs.original: यथा वसु वीरजातं नशामहै तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: yathā vasu vīrajātaṃ naśāmahai taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 12. In great enkindled Agni's keeping, and, for bliss, free from all sin before Mitra and Varuna.
paragraphs.original: महो अग्नेः समिधानस्य शर्मण्यनागा मित्रे वरुणे स्वस्तये ।
paragraphs.translit: maho agneḥ samidhānasya śarmaṇyanāgā mitre varuṇe svastaye |

paragraphs.text: May we share Savitar's best animating help. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.
paragraphs.original: श्रेष्ठे स्याम सवितुः सवीमनि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे
paragraphs.translit: śreṣṭhe syāma savituḥ savīmani taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe

paragraphs.text: 13. All ye, the Gods whom Savitar the Father of truth, and Varuna and Mitra govern,
paragraphs.original: ये सवितुः सत्यसवस्य विश्वे मित्रस्य व्रते वरुणस्य देवाः ।
paragraphs.translit: ye savituḥ satyasavasya viśve mitrasya vrate varuṇasya devāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Give us prosperity with hero children, and opulence in kine and various treasure.
paragraphs.original: ते सौभगं वीरवद्गोमदप्नो दधातन द्रविणं चित्रमस्मे
paragraphs.translit: te saubhagaṃ vīravadgomadapno dadhātana draviṇaṃ citramasme

paragraphs.text: 14. Savitar, Savitar from east and westward, Savitar, Savitar from north and southward,
paragraphs.original: सविता पश्चातात्सविता पुरस्तात्सवितोत्तरात्तात्सविताधरात्तात् ।
paragraphs.translit: savitā paścātātsavitā purastātsavitottarāttātsavitādharāttāt |

paragraphs.text: Savitar send us perfect health and comfort, Savitar let our days of life be lengthened!
paragraphs.original: सविता नः सुवतु सर्वतातिं सविता नो रासतां दीर्घमायुः
paragraphs.translit: savitā naḥ suvatu sarvatātiṃ savitā no rāsatāṃ dīrghamāyuḥ
